What brings you in?

A heart concern

Discuss ongoing concerns such as palpitations, or get a cardiology review after a referral.

A report or second opinion

Bring an ECG, echo, angiogram or treatment recommendation and ask what it means for you.

Prevention or follow-up

Discuss heart risk from high blood pressure, cholesterol, diabetes or family history, or review an existing care plan.

Meet the heart team

For a first heart consultation or report review, ask for cardiology. If you’ve been advised to consider heart surgery, ask for a surgical opinion.

Plan your visit

What happens at the consultation?

The cardiologist will ask about your concerns and health history, review any reports you bring, and explain the next steps. They may recommend tests such as an ECG or echocardiogram if needed.

What should I bring?

Bring previous reports or scans, your prescriptions or a list of medicines, and any referral letter you have.

Can I book for a parent or family member?

Yes. Use your own number if you’re coordinating the visit, and tell the team who the appointment is for when they contact you. You can ask about the patient’s preferred language when booking.

How do I check fees, timings or insurance?

Call +91 92814 43956 to ask about the consultation fee, the doctor’s next available slot and whether your plan covers the visit. The appointment team confirms your slot.
